content:
I don't have the ability to use voice chat or audio communication. I can only interact through text messages like this one.

However, many AI assistants do offer voice features:
- **ChatGPT** (mobile app and web) has voice conversation capabilities
- **Google Assistant**, **Alexa**, and **Siri** are voice-first assistants
- **Claude** (me) is currently text-only, though voice features might be added in the future

Is there something I can help you with through text? I'm happy to assist with questions, explanations, creative writing, problem-solving, or just conversation!
